title: Order Service Outage from HikariCP Pool Misconfiguration
root_cause: A PR inadvertently lowered the DB connection pool size from 50 to 5 in production Helm values, causing immediate connection timeouts during peak traffic.
resolution: Rolled back Helm release and added automated configuration linter in CI to enforce minimum pool sizing standards.
lessons_learned: Never allow manual pool downsizing without load testing validation.

title: Payment Service Downtime Due to Stuck Unindexed Query
root_cause: An unindexed audit logging query performed a sequential table scan, exhausting all 500 database connection slots in idle-in-transaction status.
resolution: Terminated idle connections, created composite index on payment_audit_logs(created_at, merchant_id), and set 15s session timeout.
lessons_learned: All new queries touching tables >1M rows must include EXPLAIN ANALYZE verification in code review.

title: Auth Service CrashLoop from Token Revocation Memory Leak
root_cause: In-memory revocation map did not implement TTL expiration, resulting in heap exhaustion and Kubelet OOMKill (ExitCode 137).
resolution: Replaced unbounded map with Guava Cache with 100k max items and 1-hour expiration.
lessons_learned: All in-memory caches must be bounded and explicitly specify an eviction policy.

title: Redis Eviction Storm During Black Friday Sale
root_cause: Redis maxmemory-policy was set to noeviction, rejecting all write operations once memory reached 16GB.
resolution: Changed policy to volatile-lru on live cluster and updated Terraform IaC definitions.
lessons_learned: Default cache policy for Redis must always be LRU/LFU eviction.
